posts.author: snakes_
posts.body:
Hi all. I'm working with Visustella's Parallax plugin to try to pin my image to the RPG Maker map. I am using the Map Lock feature, and it seems to work ok. The problem is the placement of the parallax image. It seems RPG Maker is drawing the parallax from the top left corner of the player screen, rather than the top left corner of the map.
I have the map set to the exact pixel dimensions as the parallax image, but no matter how the player enters the map, it is always drawn from the top left corner of the screen, causing unwanted placement and also causing the parallax image to tile (which shouldn't be happening since the map and the image are the same size).
Does anyone have any ideas? thanks
Edit: Solved. It started working on it's own without my doing anything...
